name: Monoclonal Mast Cell Activation Syndrome

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Consensus Diagnostic Criteria for Monoclonal Mast Cell Activation Syndrome

criteria.description: Presence of clonal mast cell markers such as KIT D816V mutation or aberrant CD25 expression on mast cells
Recurrent episodes of mast cell activation symptoms affecting multiple organ systems
Elevated serum tryptase levels or other mast cell mediator markers during symptomatic episodes
Absence of diagnostic criteria for systemic mastocytosis on bone marrow biopsy

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of clonal mast cell markers plus at least two minor criteria including recurrent mast cell activation symptoms and elevated mediator levels
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of systemic mastocytosis and other mast cell disorders.

pathognomonic.notes: Severe systemic reactions triggered by mast cell mediator release

pathognomonic.symptomName: Flushing with pruritus and urticaria pigmentosa-like skin lesions
searchTerms: red skin with hives and itching

pathognomonic.notes: Reflects increased mast cell burden or activation
searchTerms: elevated mast cell marker in blood

common.symptomName: Abdominal cramping and diarrhea due to mast cell mediator release
searchTerms: stomach cramps and diarrhea from mast cells
abdominal pain with diarrhea due to mast cell release
digestive symptoms from mast cell activation

common.symptomName: Headache and dizziness during mast cell activation episodes
searchTerms: headache and dizziness during mast cell episodes
migraine and lightheadedness with mast cell activation
head pain and vertigo during flare-ups
bone pain or low bone density
fast heartbeat and palpitations during attacks

occasional.symptomName: Non-specific cognitive difficulties or brain fog

searchTerms: sudden loss of consciousness without allergy

laboratory: Elevated baseline and episodic serum tryptase
Detection of KIT D816V mutation in peripheral blood or bone marrow
Aberrant expression of CD25 on mast cells
imaging: Bone densitometry showing osteopenia or osteoporosis
Bone marrow biopsy without dense mast cell infiltrates
genetic: Somatic KIT D816V mutation in mast cells
other: Elevated urinary histamine metabolites during symptomatic episodes

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of dense mast cell infiltrates in bone marrow biopsy
Major diagnostic criteria for systemic mastocytosis fulfilled
Absence of clonal mast cell markers

redFlags: Rapidly rising serum tryptase during episodes
Signs of systemic mastocytosis requiring urgent hematology referral
